headline: SSH opened to the entire internet on production app servers — understand this is a significant security exposure even if temporary.

findings.evidence_ref: New ingress rule with `cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]` and port 22 in the diff
findings.explanation: SSH (port 22) is now accessible from anywhere on the internet to production app instances. This opens the attack surface to brute-force, credential spraying, and SSH-based exploits, even if the follow-up ticket will eventually move to Session Manager.
